claims.claim_text: The indexed Sergeant Guy B. Bailey is confirmed in the official Army enlistment table.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier matches exactly, and the initials and Sergeant grade agree across the two official NARA records.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact unique private identifier plus compatible initials and grade across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army table records a November 1945 entry or recall and Sergeant grade. Its relationship to the timing of OSS service is not established.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is not quoted or exposed. Common-name and unrelated exact-name web candidates were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At an Army entry or recall in November 1945, Guy B. Bailey's record carried a dairy farm-hand occupation category.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army table records a dairy farm-hand occupation category but names no farm or employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private-identifier agreement plus compatible initials and Sergeant grade with the OSS index.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented occupation in an Army record dated November 23, 1945. Whether it preceded OSS service, followed it, or was historical coding is unresolved.
claims.match_notes: This is an occupation-only finding. No farm, dairy, or other employer is inferred, and the claim is excluded from employer and affiliation counts.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Corporal Harry F. Bailey is confirmed in the official Army enlistment table.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name and a private identifier match; the 1940 Private grade is compatible with later advancement to Corporal.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact name and an exact unique private identifier across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army table documents enlistment from civil life on October 17, 1940, before the OSS existed; the indexed Corporal grade is compatible with later promotion.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is not quoted or exposed. Common-name and unrelated exact-name web candidates were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry in October 1940, Harry F. Bailey reported a semiskilled bus, taxi, truck, or tractor driver occupation category.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Semiskilled chauffeurs and drivers, bus, taxi, truck, and tractor
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army table records the driver occupation and entry from civil life, but no employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact name and exact private-identifier agreement with the OSS index.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented civilian occupation at Army entry on October 17, 1940. It predates OSS, but no employer or later recruitment sequence is established.
claims.match_notes: This is an occupation-only finding. No transport company, garage, farm, or other employer is inferred, and the claim is excluded from employer analytics.
